notes: Summary: Mid-market product company building an in-app assistant and semantic search layer. Completed 4-week Hosted API trial; moving to evaluate Dedicated for predictable throughput and cost modeling.
Hosted trial takeaways: quick SDK onboarding, token-level billing visibility useful for finance. Observed measurable UX lift on assistant flows.
Trial traffic snapshot: steady-state QPS ~12; typical concurrency 30-40; feature-release bursts reached ~65 QPS.
Observed token mix: ~60% short requests (<=128 tokens total), ~30% mid-length requests (129-1024 tokens), ~10% long (>1024 tokens). Average response length ~160 tokens.
Workload breakdown: 55% chat/assistant, 30% semantic-search (embeddings + reranking), 15% async summarization and nightly batch re-ranks.
Performance targets: P95 <250ms for short assistant turns; P95 <400ms for search reranks. High cost sensitivity; needs predictable unit costs before Dedicated commitment.
Dedicated sizing ask: provide GPU options and node counts for 1) current trial scale, 2) 3x growth over 12 months; include cost, latency, autoscaling guidance and surge policies.
POC constraints: 2-week Dedicated proof-of-concept; requires SOC2 evidence, SSO/SAML, KMS key management, and audit export capability.
Eng director quote: "We liked hosted predictability; show the QPS->GPU math and examples for token-mix impact on concurrency."
Sales action: AE to provide SKU-level Dedicated pricing, surge/overage rules, and a traffic forecast template mapping QPS and token mix to GPU counts.
SE recommendation: two initial logical configs for current peaks: 4 x H100-equivalent or 8 x A100-80GB-equivalent; autoscale headroom to 12 logical GPUs for 3x growth scenario.
Security asks: provide KMS/HSM integration diagram, data residency controls, and export of audit logs. Security review in progress (drive docs linked).
Next meetings planned: infra deep-dive (wk of 2026-03-03), procurement check-in with finance (wk of 2026-03-10).
